compound-interest.keyword: Compound interest calculator with monthly contributions
compound-interest.description: Project fixed monthly deposits using a nominal annual rate compounded monthly. Compare your contributions with modeled earnings; use the complete examples below to change timing or inflation.
Use daily compounding with monthly deposits. This example keeps the same nominal rate and deposit schedule as the monthly case; daily compounding does not add daily contributions.
Convert a 5% nominal rate compounded monthly to an equivalent annual rate while preserving effective yield. Changing the quote is different from holding a nominal rate fixed.

boat-loan.description: Calculate the monthly payment from purchase price, cash down payment, trade value and entered tax and fees. Compare total loan interest and upfront cash; ownership expenses are separate.
aliases: Boat loan calculator with down payment

boat-loan.keyword: Boat price from a monthly loan budget
boat-loan.description: Work backward from a $700 monthly loan-payment budget. The result is a modeled purchase price under the complete entered assumptions, with operating and storage expenses budgeted separately.

savings.description: Project your ending balance from starting savings and deposits. Monthly and annual deposits can increase each year; separate contributions, earnings and purchasing power.
Keep your target and deadline fixed to solve the monthly deposit. This example starts with $2,000 and targets $20,000 in five years at an assumed constant 4% APY.
Keep monthly deposits fixed and find the first whole month reaching the target. This restores the $2,000 start, $20,000 goal, $300 monthly deposits and 4% APY example.
Enter an APY quote as APY, rather than dividing it by twelve as a nominal rate. This hypothetical 4% APY example fetches no current bank rates; the compounding selector is ignored for APY.
